# Video Test Recipe
A delicious pasta recipe with an embedded video demonstration.

# Ingredients
- 400g spaghetti
- 4 egg yolks
- 100g pecorino romano
- 150g guanciale
- Black pepper

# Directions
1. Cook the pasta in boiling salted water.
2. Crisp the guanciale in a skillet.
3. Mix egg yolks with pecorino and black pepper.
4. Toss pasta with guanciale and egg mixture off heat.
